title: Signal in the Snow
brief: A radio plays Kate's warning before she has spoken it. James opens the station door to help someone outside and disappears. Kate transmits the warning we heard at the start. A complete 38-second warning loop with a choice and a consequence, rather than an episode teaser.
style: Cold blue-white cinematic realism with warm lamp accents, 35mm grain. Restrained natural performances and consistent approved Kate and James designs. No captions or extra people.

shots.action: The radio receives Kate's own urgent warning.
shots.prompt: Close insert of the station radio on the wooden desk. The receive light glows. No people are visible.
shots.camera: Locked close insert, no camera movement

shots.action: Kate recognizes her voice coming from the radio.
shots.prompt: Kate alone beside the radio, her hand still above the controls. Recognition replaces concentration.

shots.action: Hearing a desperate knock, James decides someone needs help outside.
shots.prompt: James alone in the station near the closed door. He hears knocking, looks toward the door, and speaks with concern.
shots.camera: Locked medium close-up of James facing the door

shots.action: James's gloved hand opens the door latch.
shots.prompt: Close insert of James's orange survival sleeve and gloved hand moving the simple metal latch. One deliberate action, no face or extra hands.

shots.action: A hard cut reveals the open doorway with James gone.
shots.prompt: Empty open station doorway filled with windblown snow. No person or silhouette inside or outside. The disappearance occurs across the edit, never as a morph.
shots.camera: Locked medium shot facing the empty doorway

shots.action: Kate looks toward the empty doorway and calls James.
shots.prompt: Kate alone at the radio desk, looking toward the doorway outside this frame. Hold her realization. No man in the background.

shots.action: Kate presses transmit and speaks the opening warning.
shots.prompt: Kate alone with the radio microphone, speaking the warning in the same voice heard at the opening. Hold the transmit light as her sentence ends. End on matching radio static.
shots.camera: Locked close-up of Kate and radio microphone
